# Brief: Workflow Artifact Identity

Slug: workflow-artifact-identity

## Objective

Deepen existing Workflow Artifact module so exact root-owned workflow-only executables have one admission, retained-source, identity, crash-resumable transaction, proof, cleanup, and resume contract without becoming product candidate content.

## Non-goals

No Go command, generic materializer, active hook, dependency, migration, feature flag, product-source write, generated-file hand edit, completed-workspace backfill, Git action, Ship action, or `.devrites/ACTIVE` change.

## Success definition

Vet binds exact artifact set and numeric limits. Green disposable preflight promotes source behind stable validated handle; held-descriptor bytes define both hash and stage. Root follows explicit pre-proof rollback or post-proof preserve branch, records durable evidence, proves candidate/readiness/built-slice separation, restores caller cursor, and stops before consumptive action.

References: `CONTEXT.md`; ADR-0018; ADR-0022; ADR-0024; canonical `workflow-artifacts.md`; accepted architecture design tree from 2026-08-12.
